name: macleanup
description: Safe-by-default macOS cleanup CLI — 28 sections, a real dry-run, zero install via npx.

scripts.version:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=require('./package.json').version;if(!fs.readFileSync('macleanup.sh','utf8').includes('MACLEANUP_VERSION:-'+v+'}')){console.error('version mismatch: package.json '+v+' is not the SCRIPT_VERSION fallback in macleanup.sh');process.exit(1)}console.log('version parity OK: '+v)"
scripts.prepublishOnly: bash -n macleanup.sh && node -c bin/macleanup.js && test -x macleanup.sh && test -x bin/macleanup.js && npm run --silent version:check
